english.note: Use 慢慢咁 as the all-purpose spoken choice for doing something at an unhurried pace.
Use this when the sentence foregrounds the deliberately slow pace of carrying out the work.

examples.english: We ate leisurely, with no need to hurry.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 maan6 maan2 gam3 sik6 m4 sai2 gap1

examples.english: I painstakingly opened the package slowly because I was afraid of damaging what was inside.
examples.traditional: 我慢慢咁拆開個包裝，驚整爛入面件嘢。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 maan6 maan2 gam3 caak3 hoi1 go3 baau1 zong1 geng1 zing2 laan6 jap6 min6 gin6 je5
